newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares nudge higher in slow holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares nudge higher in slow holiday trade.

text.p: Brazil shares ended up 0.8 percent in sluggish trade due to the Thanksgiving Day holiday in the United States, brokers said.
"The market is almost dead," said a trader, noting trading Friday was likely to remain weak.
Preliminary figures showed the Bovespa stock index closed up 530 points at 66,449 points in turnover of 226.4 million reais ($219.2 million).
Benchmark Telebras preferred shares rose 1.17 percent to close at 78 reais. Power firm Eletrobras preferred shares rose 0.3 percent to end at 339 reais.
Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred shares ended up 0.23 percent at 21.70 reais. Oil monopoly Petrobras closed at 140 reais, up 0.36 percent.
